name: 瞳孔不安指数分析
description: Measures pupillary unrest (hippus) — natural pupil oscillations absent in AI-generated faces.
mechanism:
This method analyzes pupillary unrest (hippus) for deepfake detection:

1. **瞳孔Size测量**: Pupil diameter is measured per frame using iris-pupil boundary detection and ellipse fitting. High-resolution tracking captures the temporal signal of pupil diameter changes.

2. **Hippus检测**: Pupillary unrest (hippus) is the continuous, involuntary oscillation of pupil diameter at frequencies of 0.5-2 Hz with amplitude of 0.2-0.5mm. This is a normal physiological phenomenon reflecting sympathetic-parasympathetic nervous system interplay. The method checks for the presence and characteristics of hippus.

3. **Pupillary光线Reflex**: When illumination changes, pupils should constrict (light increase) or dilate (light decrease) with characteristic latency (~200ms) and dynamics (rapid constriction, slower dilation). The method checks for correct pupillary light reflex dynamics. Deepfakes typically don't model this physiological response.

4. **Bilateral瞳孔Coordination**: Both pupils should show consensual response — constricting/dilating together with minimal difference (≤0.5mm). The method checks bilateral pupil size correlation. AI generators may produce independent pupil sizes between left and right eyes, violating the consensual pupil response.

5. **Cognitive瞳孔Response**: Cognitive effort and emotional arousal produce small pupil dilations (0.1-0.5mm above baseline). The method analyzes whether pupil size correlates with speech content complexity and emotional context. Deepfake pupils that don't respond to cognitive demands lack this natural physiological signal.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用

references.title: Ciftci, U.A. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos Using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Li, Y. & Lyu, S. (2019). Exposing DeepFake Videos By Detecting Face Warping Artifacts. CVPR Workshop.
